name: Router terminal (SSH)

license.summary: Open source (AGPL-3.0). Free to use. Official extension by Teliti.

description: SSH terminal to your routers, opened from a router's action menu in a bottom panel with tabs. Uses the router account Telemon already stores and pins each router's host key.

actions.label: Open terminals
actions.description: Open an SSH shell on routers. The shell has the full rights of the router account.

permissions.description: Open SSH shells on routers that allow writing from Telemon. Every session is audited.
